{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out rows with biomarker_baseline == -999 (QC failure)
df_filtered = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Print number of rows after filtering
print(f"Number of rows after filtering -999: {len(df_filtered)}")

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
# Group by patient_id and select the row with max sample_seq
df_dedup = df_filtered.loc[df_filtered.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Print number of rows after deduplication
print(f"Number of rows after deduplication (one per patient): {len(df_dedup)}")

# Step 3: Compute mean baseline biomarker value (already in ng/mL, no unit correction needed)
mean_baseline = df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the mean
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL): {mean_baseline}")

# Print the number of unique patient_ids in the original data
print(f"Original unique patient_id count: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Print the number of duplicate patient_id rows (i.e. total rows - unique patient_id)
duplicate_rows = len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id rows: {duplicate_rows}")

# Print the number of patients excluded due to -999
excluded_due_to_qc = len(df) - len(df_filtered)
print(f"Number of patients excluded due to -999 in biomarker_baseline: {excluded_due_to_qc}")"}
